summary: Completed comprehensive testing of KleverCal MVP - scheduling platform with auth, meeting types, availability, bookings, and AI features. Backend APIs fully functional, frontend UI working with minor session management issues.

ui_bugs.issue: Session expires quickly during testing, redirecting users to login page

passed_tests: User login and JWT authentication functional
Dashboard stats API returns correct data
AI features (NLP scheduling & lead scoring) working with provided API key
Landing page loads with hero section and CTA buttons
Dashboard displays stats cards and navigation
Public booking page shows appropriate 'not found' for invalid slugs
Login page with Google OAuth button present
All UI elements (feature cards, testimonials, buttons) render correctly
